answer: The juniper is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the dune. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. By the prism of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, released only after three unrelated confirmations, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
